sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
Meccanica C S.p.A. holds approvals for: BR-180 (TO1, STL); BR-310 (TO2, CLM).

findings.why: The ASL is a controlled record that covers BR-220, TO1 and STL, and it lists only Alluminio B as approved. Meccanica C's approvals are for other parts (BR-180, BR-310). It has no current approval for BR-220 at TO1 for STL.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
Fastener holes: 4 x diameter 8.5 mm H12, edges deburred, no cracks or tears visible at 10x magnification.

findings.why: Meccanica C has an open 8D on cracks at fastener holes in 6061-T6 (6xxx) brackets. BR-220 is a 6xxx billet part with 4 fastener holes, and the proposed material is the same 6061-T6. The email EML-SQ-2026-1105 confirms the 8D is still open.

sources.quote: Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.

findings.why: Drawing Rev C is released and effective. It requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). The offered grade is EN AW-6061-T6, and the email's 6061-T6 / 240 MPa figures do not match the drawing in force. The claim that the strength is 'equivalent' does not meet the drawing's grade or the 250 MPa minimum.

sources.quote: Material certificates are not stored in this record.
Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01

findings.why: The only support for 6061-T6 strength is Meccanica C's verbal claim of equivalence to 6082. No certificate or test result for the offered material shows Rp0.2 against SC-01 (>= 250 MPa). Someone must supply one.
